title: The Verb Doler: Singular vs. Plural

sections.title: How doler works
sections.content:
The verb **doler** (o → ue) works just like *gustar*: the body part that hurts is the subject of the sentence! Therefore, you will almost exclusively use two forms:
- **duele** with singular body parts (*me duele la cabeza*)
- **duelen** with plural body parts (*me duelen los pies*)

items.spanish: Me duele la garganta desde ayer.
Después de caminar tanto, me duelen las piernas.
items.english: After walking so much, my legs hurt.

items.spanish: No puedo leer bien porque me duelen los ojos.
items.english: I cannot read well because my eyes hurt.

sections.content: Always use definite articles (*el, la, los, las*) with body parts in Spanish: say *me duele **la** cabeza*, never *me duele mi cabeza*!
